what: Measured the simulated cup grip with zero-API probes; first nine-table Dream success recorded.
why: User asked to check and improve cup physics; Dream runs were limited by cups slipping out of the jaws.
details: Batch 14: Table 3 held its cup 18.3 cm up for 5 s (target 18 cm), upright, gravity on, no attachment; video reviewed.
Exact replica of the verified mechanical grasp carries 2/9 cups; awake cups, pad friction, tighter squeeze, wider compliance and a solid one-hull collider did not improve it (0-1/9).

Likely cause: kinematic finger pads repositioned each tick transfer little friction. Options added as constants, all off; baseline restored. Reliable grasp needs driven fingers or a grasp constraint (team decision).
